overview: Hondo Ohnaka is a pirate king (bounty contractor) from Sriluur, documented across Clone Wars · Rebels. Weequay pirate who alternately hired hunters and placed bounties during Clone Wars and Rebels.
history:
Hondo Ohnaka rose from Sriluur to become a pirate king (bounty contractor) whose name appears on guild boards from the Core to the Outer Rim. Hondo Ohnaka built Florrum-based pirate empire alternately hiring bounty hunters and placing pucks on rivals—Weequay kingpin whose contracts shaped Clone Wars and Rebels hunter economies. Bounty puck archives, Imperial warrant logs, and Hutt contract registries all document Hondo Ohnaka as a contractor who shaped wars without wearing a uniform. Coverage spans all nine saga films, Clone Wars, Rebels, Mandalorian, Book of Boba Fett, Andor, KOTOR, KOTOR II, SWTOR, and Sith Empire-era mercenary markets.

Even before Hondo Ohnaka's career, Sriluur produced hunters, soldiers, and syndicate enforcers whose traditions fed the modern guild system. Hondo's Rebels era partnership with Ezra Bridger showed pirate-bounty hybrid evolution—same Hondo who fought Sugi on Felucia later aided Rebellion for profit. Hondo fought Sugi and Embo on Felucia, captured Count Dooku briefly for ransom, lost Florrum base repeatedly, and supplied Rebels with smuggler-hunter intelligence. KOTOR-era Nar Shaddaa boards and TOR-era Great Galactic War contracts show earlier generations of pirate king (bounty contractor) hunters in the same blood-stained market. Jedi, Sith, and clone troopers alike learned to respect or fear Hondo Ohnaka's approach to pursuit and extraction.
